# G01 Save and forget a language

## Acceptance

- [x] A1 WHEN a user saves a language THE app SHALL use it next session (C1)
- [x] A2 IF another user asks for it THEN THE app SHALL return 404 (C1, SB01)
- [x] A3 WHEN the user forgets it THE app SHALL NOT use it next session (C2)

## Evidence

- C1: evidenced, local, A1 and A2
- C2: evidenced, local, A3
- SB01: evidenced, tier 1, A2
- actual: 6 h
- Rulings:
  - forget is a soft delete for 30 days (why: audit; cost if wrong: retention breach)
- profile table: absent; cleanup: none needed; verified: local only
